items: Restaurants that survived recent disruption did so partly by adapting quickly and adopting technology, from QR code menus and online ordering to kitchen display systems and self-ordering kiosks.
First-party online ordering through your own website lets guests order from you directly, avoiding the high commissions third-party delivery apps charge restaurants.
Back-of-house tools such as automated inventory management and kitchen display systems linked to your POS help you reduce waste and keep orders accurate across every channel.
Choose technology providers that work with each other, so data and automation flow across marketing, ordering, operations, loyalty and reputation management.
